ACTION: Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-skills/references/claude-code.md

Before I touch the frontmatter, I'm reading the writing-skills reference on Claude Code-only keys. The fix for "only runs when someone types /refund-issue" is `disable-model-invocation: true`, which is a Claude Code extension, and that skill says to read this reference before setting one.

The reason I'm stopping here is your second requirement. As I understand Claude Code, `disable-model-invocation: true` does more than block Claude from starting the skill on its own. It also stops the skill from being preloaded into a subagent through `skills:`. If so, the obvious one-line fix would quietly break `support-desk`'s refund flow.

Once I've read the reference, I'll do one of two things:

- **If the key leaves subagent preloading alone:** I'll add `disable-model-invocation: true`, run `build/check_frontmatter.py`, and re-run your RED scenario to confirm the agent no longer starts a refund on its own. I'll also check that `support-desk` still issues refunds.
- **If it blocks preloading, as I expect:** your two requirements can't both be met with this one skill and flag. I'll bring you options before editing anything. One option is to split it into two skills. A user-only `refund-issue` would have the flag. A separate skill that only `support-desk` preloads would have no model-triggerable description. Its body would require explicit approval, enforced by a guard, since a description alone isn't one. The guard would be a tool permission or hook on the billing API's refund call.

I'll report back with what the reference says.
